burpee.prompt: Black-and-white fine-art sports photography, deep black background (#070707), single hard rim light, heavy film grain, high contrast, cinematic, 16:9. Figures are backlit silhouettes with faces in shadow and not identifiable. No text, no logos, no letters, no watermark. A lone athlete at the top of an explosive burpee jump in a dark studio, arms stretched overhead, sweat droplets flying and catching the light, dust in the air.

climber.prompt: Black-and-white fine-art sports photography, deep black background (#070707), single hard rim light, heavy film grain, high contrast, cinematic, 16:9. Figures are backlit silhouettes with faces in shadow and not identifiable. No text, no logos, no letters, no watermark. Low-angle close shot of a person doing fast mountain climbers on the floor of a dark studio, motion blur on the legs, intense effort, rim light along the back and arms.

crowd.prompt: Black-and-white fine-art sports photography, deep black background (#070707), single hard rim light, heavy film grain, high contrast, cinematic, 16:9. Figures are backlit silhouettes with faces in shadow and not identifiable. No text, no logos, no letters, no watermark. About fifty people in a dark event hall doing jumping squats in perfect sync, seen from behind and slightly above, a strobe of white light cutting through haze, energetic and unified.

meditate.prompt: Black-and-white fine-art sports photography, deep black background (#070707), single hard rim light, heavy film grain, high contrast, cinematic, 16:9.
